title: Each work order appears in every tab matching one of its line states
refs: SV-8658 (WIP spec v24 per Chris Ward 2026-08-19; Story 2; line-state placement S3-R5,S3-R6 - a mixed-state work order appears in each matching tab)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Several open ZZAUTOTEST service work orders exist within the current date range, including one open estimate with no approved line items at all.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. For each seeded work order, count how many times its work order number appears across all four tabs.
3. Find the estimate with nothing approved and read its money columns.
expected:
1. A qualifying work order appears in each tab that matches one of its line states, showing only that tab's slice of its money - a work order carrying lines in more than one state appears in more than one tab. The status column still shows the work order's true status.
2. The work order with nothing approved yet still appears (in the Estimates tab), with its earned and remaining both showing "$0.00".

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and story SV-8658 (WIP Story 2), and the Work In Progress report specification version 28, which describes the line-state placement model (S3-R5, S3-R6): the report treats a work order as a sum of its lines, so a work order appears in each tab matching one of its line states, showing only that tab's slice of the money. Chris Ward confirmed this and tidied the specification to the line-state model on 19 August 2026, recorded in his answers in this file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bilalmuzamil-sketch/Manual-test-Cases/claude/slack-session-0sxnd9/build/report-suite/chris-answers-2026-08-19/WIP-CHRIS-RULINGS-2026-08-19.md.
